AboutStr: Attention, the launther involvs registry modification and files replacement, some antivirus software might report virus, for the integrity of the client data it is recommended to kill the antivirus software before running. This program is competly open open source, and will not publish user data, the code in the networking section of this launcher is for version detection and announcement acquisition only, Writer: DawnFz (ねねだん) && Catboss, Email: catboss2023@outlook.com.
